name: crew
description: Your orchestrator companion, a pixel-art mascot you talk to, hands the work to a crew of background workers and coordinates them, with a pane, a status line and rows in the conversation that show who is doing what.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of the crew's panel and rows: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, English when it names no other the crew speaks.

usageProbe.title: Usage probe
usageProbe.description: Whether the crew asks a headless claude -p for Fable's weekly window, which only /usage has, at most every 3 minutes: off shows the engine's usage windows only.

napAfter.title: Nap after
napAfter.description: How long a free or finished worker stays in the panel's row once its status changes, a finished one at least while its end stands out (30 seconds): never keeps it there. The team view and the roster always have it.
